notes.title: Fixed a typo in ASCII explanation
notes.content: Fixed a typo in the ASCII explanation for character "a" near the start of the game. The binary code was 11000001 while it should have been 01100001.

notes.title: Check out my new puzzle game
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063850/Block_Buster_Billy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063850/Block_Buster_Billy/[/url]

Block Buster Billy is a game best described as Baba is Number.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33644177/5bac2a4332e45f2deea9862388fcf812856a10bb.png[/img]

It's a puzzle game where you move blocks with digits and basic math operations to form numbers and equations. When you complete an equation, it turns into a big block you can move out of the way to open the treasure chest.

Combining these simple rules with carefully placed blocks leads to some very challenging puzzles.

[list]
[*] Over 100 hand crafted levels
[*] Turn based gameplay
[*] Non-linear progress
[*] Mostly light math, but tricky level layouts
[*] A goofy story about aliens visiting Billy's island
[/list]

There are different paths you can take on each island, so you don't have to play the levels in some particular order. If you get stuck on one puzzle, you can go back to the island and select another level.

Levels are linked. Solving a level gives you a piece for the level you entered from. 

I hope you will like this game even more than Rogue Bit.

Have fun playing!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063850/Block_Buster_Billy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063850/Block_Buster_Billy/[/url]

notes.title: Achievements and more...
notes.content:
Version 1.2.2 is online:

- Added achievements 
- Updated the map to contain two secrets you can find
- Fixed a bug that allowed skipping 4 puzzles near the end of the game
- Added a higher resolution character set table for 1080p and bigger displays
- Added a safe-mode launch option for players who had problems launching the game
- Minor spelling fixes in the level descriptions

If you started a game before this release and want to get the achievements, you need to start a new game, because the achievement checkpoints are saved inside the savefile and the old versions had none.

Safe Mode Note: While achievements will work, they won't be uploaded to Steam in safe mode. The achievements will register and will be saved to your local disk, but won't be uploaded to Steam.

Update (Feb 11) version 1.2.3:

- improved saving speed
- pressing F4 in level editor moves the player out from registers so you cannot get stuck while editing levels

notes.title: New features
notes.content:
Version 1.1.2 is now online with a couple of new features based on player feedback:

- you can press X at any time to get the conversion table between decimal, hexadecimal, binary values and ASCII characters.
- menu is now usable with the mouse, so you can use the mouse to set up the keyboard or joystick controls in case they are misconfigured
- changes to keyboard bindings now work in menus too (they used to only work in the game).

Have fun playing @
